grh_7baf6f6dcbb54979e383.title: The Living Doll
paragraphs: Cynthia Browning's lifelike doll, made with her own hair and nail clippings, is found stabbed through the heart, and Holmes learns that an old 'wise woman' has been hired to use black magic against the child. When the woman is found beaten to death, money around her seems to point toward suitors named King or Pound, but her final act is to clutch a sixpence. Remembering the slang term 'tanner' for that coin, Holmes exposes Hugh Tanner, who wanted Cynthia removed so Mrs. Browning would be free to marry him and then killed the ineffective accomplice to silence her. Tanner confesses before the police arrive.
